text: The Tetrahedron Prize for Creativity in Organic Chemistry or Bioorganic and Medicinal Chemistry is awarded each year by Elsevier, the publisher of Tetrahedron Publications. The prize was founded in 1980 and is named in honour of the founding co-chairmen of these publications, Professor Sir Robert Robinson and Professor Robert Burns Woodward.
